notes: Clean review: no new quantified exploit in chunk 'scripts'. Scope (ACTION-REVIEW-SEC-004): all 33 manifest files read in full; nothing removed from scope; no partners. Not re-reported as known-ledger variants: acdsl-policy-guard bypass via Bash cp/sed and path normalization (security-MIN-3-r2), repos.json -> additionalDirectories widening incl. the agent-writable repos.json angle (security-MAJ-4-r1), dropped acdsl ask rules (correctness-MAJ-24-r1). Probes (SEC-003): no exploit claim, so no curl/probe was due. Cross-chunk for the station: whether the smine-orchestrate skill's allowed-tools manifest (outside this chunk) lets the orchestrate agent Write <repo_root>/repos.json — if so, security-MAJ-4-r1 is reachable by agent action alone, not only by operator registry edits.
